Procurement Officer Job at African Industries Group




        
    

        
        African Industries Group (AIG) is a diversified global conglomerate with a legacy of 52 years of business excellence and sustainable growth. It is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It has been contributing to Nigeria’s socio-economic growth and industrial development and is equally committed towards the nurturing and development of the local community.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Procurement Officer

Job Location: Ikorodu, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Requirements
     

            
    




	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
	3–5 years of procurement experience, preferably within a steel plant or steel manufacturing environment.
	Strong negotiation, vendor management, and sourcing skills.
	Good knowledge of procurement processes, inventory management, and cost control.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) and ERP systems is an added advantage.
	Candidates residing in Ikorodu or nearby areas are strongly preferred.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “Procurement Officer” as the subject of the email.

Note: Candidates residing in Ikorodu or nearby areas are strongly preferred.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position:  Procurement Officer

Job Location: Joseph Nahman Cl, Victoria Island, Lagos 106104, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Source and evaluate suppliers based on quality, price, availability, and service.
	Obtain and compare quotations and negotiate favourable commercial terms.
	Prepare purchase orders and ensure timely processing and delivery of approved purchases.

	Support supplier onboarding, evaluation, and performance monitoring.
	Work closely with Inventory, Retail/F&B, Finance, and other departments to understand and fulfil procurement requirements.

	Resolve supplier-related issues and escalate significant concerns to the Procurement Manager.


Qualifications

	Bachelor’s degree or HND in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience:


	
	2–4 years of relevant experience in procurement, preferably within retail, hospitality, FMCG, entertainment, or a similar fast-paced environment.

title: Job Openings at Filmhouse Cinemas Limited
content:
Filmhouse Cinemas Limited is a dynamic film exhibition company. Our expertise are in the areas of: Cinema operations, management of sites, Ownership of sites, Consultancy for cinema development, Design Fit-out; Cinema project management, Film Distribution: Rights Acquisition, Booking into cinemas, and content development.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Customer Service Representative (Team Member)

Job Location: Joseph Nahman Cl, Victoria Island, Lagos 106104, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
Essential duties and key responsibilities include the following and other duties as may be assigned:
     

            
    




	Selling box office tickets, responding to queries reservations and sales.
	Monitoring and maintaining cash flow, ensuring that there are no shortages.
	Ensuring that guests are well guided to entrance and exit into the cinema.
	Monitoring and maintaining guest flow, ensuring that there are no obstructions to guest cinematic experience.
	Participating in briefings and other meetings as requested by the cinema manager.
	Attend and participate in training sessions as required by managers and HR.
	Contribute to increasing concession revenues.
	Responsible in the arrangement and cleaning of designated areas.


Qualifications


	ND (National Diploma)
	HND (Higher National Diploma)
	BSc / BSE (Bachelor’s Degree)
	Diploma
	NCE (Nigerian Certificate in Education)
	SSCE


Age Requirement


	Candidates must be between 19 and 26 years old.


Application Closing Date: 7th November, 2026.

Click here to apply online

 

2.) Procurement Officer

Job Location: Joseph Nahman Cl, Victoria Island, Lagos 106104, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Source and evaluate suppliers based on quality, price, availability, and service.
	Obtain and compare quotations and negotiate favourable commercial terms.
	Prepare purchase orders and ensure timely processing and delivery of approved purchases.
	Maintain accurate procurement records, supplier information, and documentation.
	Monitor purchase orders and follow up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery.
	Support supplier onboarding, evaluation, and performance monitoring.
	Work closely with Inventory, Retail/F&B, Finance, and other departments to understand and fulfil procurement requirements.
	Identify cost-saving opportunities and recommend suitable alternatives where necessary.
	Ensure all procurement activities comply with company policies, approval processes, and agreed specifications.
	Resolve supplier-related issues and escalate significant concerns to the Procurement Manager.


Qualifications
Education:


	Bachelor’s degree or HND in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Professional procurement/supply chain certification is an added advantage.


Experience:


	
	2–4 years of relevant experience in procurement, preferably within retail, hospitality, FMCG, entertainment, or a similar fast-paced environment.
	


Additional Information
Skills & Competencies:


	Strong negotiation and supplier management skills.
	Good understanding of procurement processes and documentation.
	Strong analytical and numerical skills.
	Good communication and relationship-management skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
	Strong attention to detail and organisation.
	Ability to work independently, manage multiple requests, and meet deadlines.
	High level of integrity, accountability, and commercial awareness


Application Closing Date: 7th November, 2026.

Click here to apply online

 

 

3.) Branch Manager

Job Location: Ring Road - Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time
Business Type: Eatery/ Restaurant

Job Summary


	We are looking for an experienced and result-driven Branch Manager to oversee the daily operations of our eatery, ensure excellent customer service, manage staff and drive sales and profitability.


Responsibilities


	Supervise, train and motivate staff.
	Ensure excellent customer service and customer satisfaction.
	Prepare and submit regular operational reports.
	Ensure the branch meets its sales and performance target.
	Resolve customer complaints and operational issues


Requirements


	HND / B.Sc Degree in Business Administration, Hospitality management.
	2-4 years as an operational manager, Branch Manager or relative field
	Good knowledge of sales, inventory and staff management.
	Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks.


Salary
N150,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 20th October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note: For more enquiries, contact this Whatsapp number: 09047710414.    

    

        Click here to Apply

  "title": "Sales Executive",
  "description": "At DGL Limited, we grow our clients&rsquo; businesses by listening to and understanding their needs, hence partnering with them to achieve their goals. We link manufacturers with numerous customers in over 100 cities and villages across Nigeria, getting their products to them seamlessly and rapidly.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Sales Executive

Job Location: Benin, Edo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are seeking a results-driven and customer-focused Sales Executive to join our team.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for generating new business, developing client relationships, promoting the company&rsquo;s logistics services, and achieving assigned sales targets.


Responsibilities


	Identify and develop new business opportunities and potential clients.
	Generate leads through networking, referrals, market research, and other sales channels.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
	Promote and sell the company&rsquo;s logistics and related services.
	Prepare and deliver sales presentations, proposals, and quotations to clients.
	Follow up on leads, proposals, and client enquiries to convert opportunities into business.
	Meet and exceed assigned monthly and quarterly sales targets.
	Maintain accurate records of sales activities, prospects, and client interactions.
	Monitor market trends and competitor activities and provide relevant feedback to management.
	Collaborate with Operations, Customer Service, and other departments to ensure effective service delivery.
	Prepare regular sales reports and provide updates on sales performance and pipeline.
	Participate in client visits, meetings, networking events, and other&nbsp;business development activities as required.


Requirements
Education:


	
	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Logistics, or a related field.
	


Experience:


	Minimum of 2&ndash;3 years of experience in sales, business development, logistics, or a related field.
	Experience in the logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, FMCG, or related industry will be an advantage.
	Proven track record of achieving sales targets is preferred.


Other Requirements:


	Must demonstrate a strong ability to generate and convert leads into paying customers.
	Must be willing to travel for client meetings and business development activities when required.
	Must possess a high level of professionalism, integrity, and accountability.
	Must be proactive, self-motivated, and commercially minded.
	Must be able to work effectively in a target-driven environment.
	Applicants with an existing network of corporate clients will be an added advantage.


Skills:


	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Strong negotiation and persuasion skills.
	Customer-focused and relationship management skills.
	Good prospecting and lead-generation abilities.
	Strong presentation and selling skills.
	Target-driven and results-oriented.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	Strong organizational and time-management skills.
	Ability to handle pressure and meet deadlines.


Remuneration


	N200,000 - N250,000 monthly depending on experience and qualifications.
	Additional sales incentives/commission may apply based on the company&#39;s approved scheme.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: dglhrexecutive@gmail.com using &ldquo;Application for Sales Executive Benin&rdquo; as the subject of the email.",

Sales Executive Job at DGL Limited




        
    

        
        At DGL Limited, we grow our clients’ businesses by listening to and understanding their needs, hence partnering with them to achieve their goals. We link manufacturers with numerous customers in over 100 cities and villages across Nigeria, getting their products to them seamlessly and rapidly.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Sales Executive

Job Location: Benin, Edo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking a results-driven and customer-focused Sales Executive to join our team.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for generating new business, developing client relationships, promoting the company’s logistics services, and achieving assigned sales targets.


Responsibilities


	Identify and develop new business opportunities and potential clients.
	Generate leads through networking, referrals, market research, and other sales channels.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
	Promote and sell the company’s logistics and related services.
	Prepare and deliver sales presentations, proposals, and quotations to clients.
	Follow up on leads, proposals, and client enquiries to convert opportunities into business.
	Meet and exceed assigned monthly and quarterly sales targets.
	Maintain accurate records of sales activities, prospects, and client interactions.
	Monitor market trends and competitor activities and provide relevant feedback to management.
	Collaborate with Operations, Customer Service, and other departments to ensure effective service delivery.
	Prepare regular sales reports and provide updates on sales performance and pipeline.
	Participate in client visits, meetings, networking events, and other business development activities as required.


Requirements
Education:


	
	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Logistics, or a related field.
	


Experience:


	Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in sales, business development, logistics, or a related field.
	Experience in the logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, FMCG, or related industry will be an advantage.
	Proven track record of achieving sales targets is preferred.


Other Requirements:


	Must demonstrate a strong ability to generate and convert leads into paying customers.
	Must be willing to travel for client meetings and business development activities when required.
	Must possess a high level of professionalism, integrity, and accountability.
	Must be proactive, self-motivated, and commercially minded.
	Must be able to work effectively in a target-driven environment.
	Applicants with an existing network of corporate clients will be an added advantage.


Skills:


	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Strong negotiation and persuasion skills.
	Customer-focused and relationship management skills.
	Good prospecting and lead-generation abilities.
	Strong presentation and selling skills.
	Target-driven and results-oriented.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	Strong organizational and time-management skills.
	Ability to handle pressure and meet deadlines.


Remuneration


	N200,000 - N250,000 monthly depending on experience and qualifications.
	Additional sales incentives/commission may apply based on the company's approved scheme.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using “Application for Sales Executive Benin” as the subject of the email.
